customMethods.name: deleteWorkOrderEvent
customMethods.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	workOrderEventId = self.view.custom.workOrders.selectedWorkOrderEventId
	
	if workOrderEventId is None: return
	system.perspective.print("deleteWorkOrderEvent() called with %s"%workOrderEventId)
	retVal, msg = system.kanoa.cmms.deleteWorkOrderEvent(workOrderEventId, userId)
		
	if msg: system.perspective.sendMessage('showWarningToast', {'message': "Couldn't delete this work order. %s"%msg})
	else: 
		system.perspective.sendMessage('showSuccessfulToast', {'message': 'Work order has been deleted'})
		self.view.custom.workOrders.selectedWorkOrderEventId = None
		
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshWorkOrders", {})
	
	return
